decisions.statement: A checkout already at the pinned commit is left alone.
Only the pinned commit is fetched.
A fetch runs at a depth of one commit.
A checkout is read for the files the checkout has before the port runs.
A checkout is ruled on by the verify module rather than by a second ruling here.
A refusal names the refused folder and the reason the ruling gave.
Every git process is started through the runner.

definition: the checkout of pinned upstream LibSets this repository ports its set data out of
